data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-L1: Application functions use Node.js 24 (latest). The remaining finding is the CDK-managed BucketDeployment provider whose runtime is controlled by aws-cdk-lib.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-COG1: Demo requirement: password policy intentionally set to the Cognito minimum (6 characters, no complexity). Production must use a strong policy.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-COG2: Demo requirement: MFA disabled so students can self-register many test accounts quickly. Production must enable MFA.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-COG8: Cognito Plus tier (threat protection) incurs per-MAU cost and is not justified for a one-day class; WAF rate limiting and API throttling provide abuse protection.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-APIG2: Request validation is implemented in the Lambda (strict allow-list schema, size limits, unit-tested) to keep rules in one place.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-APIG3: The API is fronted by CloudFront with an AWS WAF web ACL; direct execute-api calls are rejected by the origin-verify header check.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-APIG4: /api/health is intentionally unauthenticated for Route 53 health checks and returns no data; all other routes use the Cognito authorizer.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-COG4: /api/health is intentionally unauthenticated for Route 53 health checks and returns no data; all other routes use the Cognito authorizer.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-SMG4: The origin-verify secret is consumed by CloudFront as a static custom header; rotation needs a coordinated redeploy and is out of scope for a one-day demo.

data.AwsSolutions::AwsSolutions-CFR1: No geo restriction: students may attend from any location.
